commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Better than gladly giving someone what they need is to have a pleasant face the moment you see them, and sweet words with it. Unlike giving, this depends on you and not on wealth, yet it doesn’t come naturally except to those with righteous hearts, so it is rarer.
